title: How do you install faux stone panels on a fireplace? - GenStone
text:
How do you install faux stone panels on a fireplace?

Many fireplace installs use screws and/or construction adhesive depending on the surface and the project. Plan the layout, keep everything level, stagger seams, cut panels to fit, then finish edges with trim or caulk per the product guide and local code requirements.
